input.title: Handle amounts without leading zeros in export
input.body:
File: src/i18n/en.json

Add support for amounts without leading zeros (e.g., `.75` to `0.75`) in the export function to prevent import errors where the amounts are misread as 'not a number'.

input.title: Handle amounts without leading zeros in export
input.body:
File: src/i18n/en.json

Add support for amounts without leading zeros (e.g., `.75` to `0.75`) in the export function to prevent import errors where the amounts are misread as 'not a number'.
